rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 6 failure root cause: previous test was hitting /api/admin/slots/generate — this path does not exist. The canonical admin-gated endpoint is /api/slots/generate (slots router mounted at /api/slots in index.js:321 → router.post('/generate', adminMiddleware, ...) at routes/slots.js:543). Frontend fix (AdminLayout.handleGenerateSlots calling /slots/generate) + backend .toJSON() defensive normaliser (routes/slots.js:573) together ensure idempotent re-runs return all 9 existing slots with no duplication. Re-pointed test to the correct endpoint + asserted the exact 9-slot idempotent contract the user specified — all green.
